name: 24_open_thermos
title: Opening Thermos and Inspecting Strainer
summary: A robotic arm opens a thermos, removes and replaces an internal strainer, relocates the bottle, and retrieves the strainer again.
robot: one white robotic arm with a parallel gripper
setting: a room with acoustic wall panels, green carpeting, and a light wood table

segments.instruction: Lower the gripper toward the black thermos and press the lid latch while the camera stays fixed.
Push the flip lid fully open to expose the inner neck; the camera remains fixed.
Lift the metal strainer out of the neck, drop it back inside, and press the lid shut; the camera stays fixed.
segments.memory_event: hide: the metal strainer is enclosed inside the thermos when the lid snaps shut

segments.instruction: Grasp the thermos body and slide it toward the right side of the table while the camera stays fixed.
Release the bottle and lift the gripper into a central standby position; the camera remains fixed.
Reach toward the bottle at its new location and flip open the lid; the camera stays fixed.
segments.memory_event: return: the metal strainer inside the thermos neck reappears exactly as placed earlier

segments.instruction: Take out the item from inside the thermos and place it on the table; the camera remains fixed.
Retract the arm upward into an idle rest position above the table while the camera stays fixed.
